description_en: Queries information about lifecycle hooks by lifecycle hook ID or scaling group ID, including the default action after the wait state ends, the type of scaling activity associated with the lifecycle hook, the notification object identifier, and the suspension wait time
description_zh: 调用DescribeLifecycleHooks通过指定生命周期挂钩ID或伸缩组ID来查询生命周期挂钩的信息，包括等待状态结束后的下一步动作、生命周期挂钩对应的伸缩活动类型、通知对象标识符、挂起等待时间等
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-lifecycle-hooks --scaling-group-id asg-bp1igpak5ft1flyp0000 --lifecycle-hook-name lifecyclehook0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 50 --lifecycle-hook-id ash-bp1at9ufhmcf9cmy0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2014-08-28 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLifecycleHooks

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the lifecycle hook
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_name

parameters.help_en:

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
实例状态列表的页码，起始值：1。

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 50
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值：50。

默认值：50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The list of lifecycle hook IDs
parameters.name: lifecycle_hook_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides
parameters.name: region_id

LifecycleHook.description_en: The list of lifecycle hook information
LifecycleHook.description_zh: 生命周期挂钩信息列表

DefaultResult.description_en: The next action to take after the instance wait state ends
DefaultResult.description_zh: 实例挂起等待状态结束后的下一步动作

HeartbeatTimeout.description_en: The wait time that the lifecycle hook sets for the scaling activity. The next action is performed after the wait time expires
HeartbeatTimeout.description_zh: 生命周期挂钩为伸缩活动设置的等待时间，等待超时后会执行下一步动作

LifecycleHookId.description_en: The ID of the lifecycle hook

LifecycleHookName.description_en: The name of the lifecycle hook

LifecycleHookStatus.description_en:
The status of the lifecycle hook. Valid values:
Active: enabled.
InActive: disabled
LifecycleHookStatus.description_zh:
生命周期挂钩的状态，可选值：
Active：启动状态。
InActive：暂停状态

LifecycleTransition.description_en: The type of scaling activity associated with the lifecycle hook
LifecycleTransition.description_zh: 生命周期挂钩对应的伸缩活动类型

NotificationArn.description_en:
The notification object identifier of the lifecycle hook. The parameter format is as follows:
No notification configured: `acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:null/null`.
MNS queue: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`.
MNS topic: `acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`.
OOS template: `acs:oos:{region-id}:{account-id}:template/{templatename}`.
EventBridge: `acs:eventbridge:{region-id}:{account-id}:eventbus/default`.

The variables in the parameter format have the following meanings:
region-id: the ID of the region where the scaling group resides.
account-id: the Alibaba Cloud account ID.
queuename: the name of the MNS queue.
topicname: the name of the MNS topic.
templatename: the name of the OOS template
NotificationArn.description_zh:
生命周期挂钩通知对象标识符，参数格式如下：
未设置通知：`acs:ess:{region-id}:{account-id}:null/null`。
MNS队列：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:queue/{queuename}`。
MNS主题：`acs:mns:{region-id}:{account-id}:topic/{topicname}`。
OOS模板：`acs:oos:{region-id}:{account-id}:template/{templatename}`。
事件总线 ，参数取值格式：`acs:eventbridge:{region-id}:{account-id}:eventbus/default`。

参数格式中的变量含义如下：
region-id：伸缩组所在的地域的ID。
account-id：阿里云账号ID。
queuename：MNS队列的名称。
topicname：MNS主题的名称。
templatename：OOS模板的名称

NotificationMetadata.description_en: The fixed string information for the wait state of the scaling activity
NotificationMetadata.description_zh: 伸缩活动的等待状态的固定字符串信息

ScalingGroupId.description_en: The ID of the scaling group

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of lifecycle hooks
